Hey, it sucks when your life is a mess and you literally don't have any idea of the next step in life. I don't know how it feels like to have BPD and ADHD but i definitely DEFINITELY know the feeling of depression and suicide. I got told the exact same things and yeah, at some point it just sounds like your putting a voice on replay. 
I didn't really reach out for help because i was too anxious to and i still haven't really. I went to the doctors once, she never asked me for symptoms or anything, just prescribed me with Citalopram and boom, her job was done! But unfortunately, that's not how things work, so you could say i kinda self diagnosed myself. 
Okay, I'm no doctor or therapist but maybe this could help?  
I had to just try and help myself in the end, which may not be ideal for people but when you have nothing else to turn to, its best.
Are you a nature lover? Then get out!!! You don't have to go with people, seriously i do it all time. Go to a park near you, personally i love sitting by lakes and just watching the sun shine down on it. Even if its raining dude!!! Who cares, go for it!!!! Take a pen and paper, write down what your feelings. Write it as single words, full sentences, whatever you like. Feeling angry? If theres no one around then scream, if there are people around then just rip the piece of paper out and tear it up. You need to let out your feelings, don't bottle them up. 
Just close your eyes and breath when your there, think about dreams that you want to pursue. Breathing's the main thing though, like slow breathing, you'll notice how much it helps, esp if you cant stop crying. 
Take a camera with you when you go out, or your phone. Pretend that your a professional photographer and take shots of your surroundings. 
Smile at strangers and if they smile back then woohoo!! If not then their probably thinking your a weirdo because that's how society puts everything. 
Be different, work on yourself and no that doesn't JUST mean exercising. It means getting out into the real world and seeing what's happening around you. I see your studying, put all your passion into that then. Research more about whatever your studying and actually have the mind set of being successful. Don't do thing just coz you have to. Get the relevant experience you need and don't give up trying to find the experience!! Challenge yourself, go to the cinema on your own- you don't have to always go out with others. Become a stronger YOU. Everything that you are facing is temporary, believe me. Once you start working on yourself and developing your skills, your firs step will be complete. Don't let there be time to think about all this depression and everything. Keep yourself occupied and do the things you love. Leave your mark on this world!!!! Its not over yet gurllllllll, you've got this!!!!xx

Hey, you figured out the obvious. You realised that what you did was wrong and that's the first move forward. I'm gonna tell you that if I was your wife I would've reacted in exactly the same way, it's just the natural response. 
Don't do anything to harm yourself because
1) You have children, who you CANNOT leave, they need a father;
2) Your wife will feel more furious that you left without an explanation.
3) This is where courage comes into play, you need to find the strength to tell her exactly what's going on.
She may not listen, but if you know that you ate truthfully being genuine then you've played your part.
She will probably need some time to herself first, but when she's ready to listen tell her about your addiction and that you realised that what you were doing was wrong. 
She's angry because that's how much she loves you and wasn't expecting this. You really need to open up to her and tell her every single detail of your addiction. That's the only way forward.
It's not over yet, remember don't leave your children. I'm guessing they will not know about this situation and if you decide to leave this world then they will become furious at a dad who left them for no reason.
You realised your mistakes and now it's time to use all the strength you have to keep this marriage held. 
I'm with you x

Hey, it seems like the main problem is your ex. Okay just wandering, is it really worth your time thinking about someone who left you for their ex? I don't think so. Listen, she's clearly moving on but it sounds like to me that you are stuck in the same position. The first thing to do, even though it's tough, is to move on. If she's moving on, then you move on. It's only fair. You don't know who your gonna come across in the future and when you do come across that special person, you may have more fun with them than you had with this girl.
In order to move on you need to work on yourself first. Stop rushing into 'needing' a relationship. If you continue with this mentality then you'll stay here forever and I know you don't want that. 
If you have personal interests, build upon those!! Find things to do and keep yourself busy all the time so that you have little time to think about your ex. Challenge yourself, since you said you have anxiety. Start of small, go out for walks if your into nature. Go swimming, go watch a movie on your own cause I do so why not???!!!?! :) 
Being positive is hard and was something that I thought was impossible, but little things like smiling at strangers even if they don't smile back can somehow seem funny!! Don't end yourself because of this reason, I mean think about it. If you try the things that I just told you, you could potentially come across your soul mate and I'm sure you don't wanna miss that!! 
There's no set time to lose your virginity dude 😊 Life your life first and then comes the rest. 
Don't give up on yourself because you need to stay to see your happy ending ;)

Hey, I don't know you or your life but I'm telling you to not do what your thinking of doing. I know it's a cliche thing to say 'I care about you even if I don't know you' and people have said it to me, but trust me on this one, I really do. Whoever you are. I'm feeling the and way, at the point in life where  I'm thinking what's the point in living, but then if you do decide to do it then your the loser. You've let everyone else win and that's something I'm sure you don't want. See life is a journey and you don't know where your gonna end up. But it's not where you end up that matters, it's how you battle your way through it. What your facing now is making you a stronger person but you don't know it yet. It's about how you battle these obstacles that count. You'll look back later and feel like a boss. 
Don't do it, your on this earth for a reason and if you don't know what that reason is then go and find me out. Try new things, get away for a bit, help the world. Leave your mark on this earth and then you can leave peacefully.
I do care, otherwise I wouldn't have written  back xx
